svg.title: Test selenium dissolution in benzene
svg.desc: The source states that benzene cannot dissolve selenium powder, so a homogeneous solution does not form. Exact mixture charges, other reagents, temperature and mixing conditions are not individually specified. Source-bound concept; no physical apparatus geometry is established.
